content:
sre-jordan: paging the on-call team — live issue with AcmeCorp VPC dedicated pool. We're seeing intermittent log drops for tenant acme-123 during indexer flushes. This looks like logs are being truncated after redaction pipeline runs. Impact: loss of request/response traces for 3% of requests since 08:03 UTC.
oncall-bot: @here Incident P2 triggered for acme-123 - dedicated pool. Pager duty: @sre-jordan. See /incidents/1796034821 for updates.
raj: on it. quick check — buffer overflow in redaction-worker shards? grabbing logs.
emily-prod: looping in product + account team. Customer is asking for full traces for legal review. They mentioned potential regulatory audit.
raj: log snippet — pasted below
```
2026-11-05T08:07:12Z redaction-worker-3 ERROR truncating event id=8a9... buffer_size=65536 processed=65000
2026-11-05T08:07:12Z pipeline redaction applied fields: user_email, ssn -> <redacted>
2026-11-05T08:07:12Z storage write partial: bytes_written=1243 total_expected=8732
```
raj: looks like redaction step emits shorter payload, then storage layer refuses chunk and we drop remainder. Might be edge-case with large nested JSONs.
customer-sre-mike: confirm on our side — we need those full traces for compliance review. Can you hold raw logs somewhere temporarily?
anna-legal: flagging legal. Any retention/PII exposure has to be reviewed. If we keep unredacted logs, we need documented purpose and TTL, and likely a signed exception.
sre-jordan: propose temporary, scoped retention exception: store raw logs for tenant acme-123 only, duration 72 hours, access limited to SRE+legal+acct team, audit log enabled. Need OK from legal + privacy and sign-off from customer.
emily-prod: we should also consider mitigations that avoid storing raw PII — e.g., capture full traces but mask PII fields with reversible tokenization held in HSM. That might be heavier.
anna-legal: tokenization approach is preferable long-term. For an incident exception: legal needs a written request from account + internal approval. I'll draft a minimal exception form. Critical: scope, TTL, access list, and disposal instructions.
raj: for live mitigation I can patch redaction-worker to increase buffer and stream chunks so we don't drop. Deploying a config change to the redaction-service (staging -> prod canary). Command: `kubectl set env deployment/redaction-worker REDACT_BUFFER=131072`
sre-jordan: do the canary to one shard in prod pool, watch errors and metric 'dropped_events_total'. Notify before scaling further.
ops-bot: deploy started: redaction-worker canary -> redaction-worker-3. CI run ok.
raj: canary metrics: errors fell to 0.2% for that shard within 30s. rolling to remaining shards with 30s stagger.
customer-sre-mike: appreciate the canary. Meanwhile can account team initiate their written request for exception? They'll need the legal template.
emily-prod: @anna-legal I'll add customer contact to the doc. Also, ops: can we create a scoped S3 bucket with server-side encryption and MFA-delete enabled for the raw files?
sre-jordan: yes. I'll create s3://redwood-temp/acme-123-legal-hold/ with lifecycle 72h and restrict IAM to the approved principals. I'll Document bucket ARN and kms key.
anna-legal: requirements: 1) Customer written request attached. 2) TTL 72 hours max. 3) Approval chain (legal + privacy + Security lead). 4) Access logged and reviewed post-incident. 5) Explicit deletion performed and attested.
emily-prod: I'll coordinate with Account to get that request ASAP. ETA 25-30 min.
raj: rolling config complete. dropped_events_total back to normal baseline. No further data lost after 08:15 UTC.
sre-jordan: summary for incident timeline so far: 08:03 first symptom; 08:07 redaction-worker observed truncation; 08:12 canary patch applied; 08:15 restored normal flow; 08:20 customer legal request in progress; 08:25 S3 bucket provisioned.
ops-bot: s3 bucket created arn:aws:s3:::redwood-temp/acme-123-legal-hold/, kms_key=alias/redwood-temporary. (access restricted, MFA-delete enabled)
anna-legal: once request is uploaded I'll produce the retention exception doc and post it here for signatures. Note: if any PII was captured, privacy will require a short impact assessment.
emily-prod: customer uploaded request at 08:31 UTC (attached in DM). I pasted it into the incident drive.
sre-jordan: initiating copy of raw segments for window 08:00-08:20 UTC only. Scripts: `./tools/collect-raw.sh --tenant acme-123 --start 2026-11-05T08:00:00Z --end 2026-11-05T08:20:00Z --dest s3://redwood-temp/acme-123-legal-hold/`
raj: copy completed. size 1.8GB. Files encrypted with KMS and marked retention TTL metadata=72h.
anna-legal: reviewed sample files. There is PII present (email addresses, partial ids). Approving exception with condition: only 4 named employees may access (sre-jordan, raj, emily-prod, anna-legal) and access must be via signed JIRA ticket and recorded.
emily-prod: acknowledging. I'll create the JIRA and add audit instructions.
customer-sre-mike: confirm they received the artifacts. Customer legal wants a signed attestation when files are deleted.
sre-jordan: we will delete at TTL expiry and produce attestation. I'll run the deletion job and post logs.
ops-bot: scheduled deletion job created: run_at=2026-11-08T08:31:00Z (72h after upload).
raj: follow-up: I'm opening a postmortem PR to add unit test for large nested events and increase default buffer.
sre-jordan: handoff to night oncall @raj_end at 08:50 UTC. If anything new pops up create a new incident thread.
emily-prod: thanks team. tagging this as mitigated and scope-limited. Next steps: formal retention exception doc, postmortem, and a customer-facing RCA draft.
anna-legal: I'll sign the exception once the JIRA and customer request are attached.
customer-sre-mike: thanks everyone. Appreciate the quick response.
sre-jordan: closing thread — will post final attestation once deletion job runs. :white_check_mark:
